claims.text: An unordered text document is a document where sentences are not arranged in a specific order, which can arise in real-world applications such as summarization and question answering.
Unordered text documents can be structured into sections using methods like the TextRank algorithm, demonstrating their practical occurrence in corpora like Wikipedia.
The process of structuring unordered documents involves clustering sentences based on keywords and their similarities, indicating that such documents are common in text processing tasks.
